justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single large anthropomorphic figure with distinctive headgear and relief-carved body ornament, and both include circular/rosette-like motifs, but these are generic correspondences. B shows a profile figure with large feathered wings holding a handled bucket beside a stylised floral column, none of which appears in A, whose frontal, massive, blocky figure with a plain disc on the chest and no attributes follows entirely different depictive conventions.
